ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the notch and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark field across both lobes. Focal high-contrast white patch centered at the median notch. Small, irregular white/light-grey clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees at the vertex point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, with distinct jagged peaks visible on the inner margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the outer margins of both lobes, tapering to sharp lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters on the right distal tip and smaller clusters on the left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, isolated vertical/oblique linear pixel disruption (white rake mark) located on the medial section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear abrasion on the right lobe; irregular jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the notch vertex.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique bifurcated white pigmentation pattern at the base of the median notch.
